Molasses Pork Tenderloin
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Dinner
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • ¼ Cup(s) molasses
  • ¼ Cup(s) brown sugar
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) lemon juice
  • 2 Teaspoon(s) kosher salt
  • ¼ Teaspoon(s) ground pepper
  • 3 Pound(s) pork tenderloin
  • ¼ Cup(s) chicken broth
Instructions
  1. Heat oven to 450° F. In a small bowl, combine the molasses, brown sugar, lemon juice, salt, and pepper and mix well. Place the pork in a roasting pan and pour the molasses glaze over the tenderloins, turning to coat evenly.
